title: verbena verecunda
intro: Verbena verecunda, commonly known as the shy verbena, is a plant species in the verbena family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that help to soothe and calm the skin, as well as reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Verbena verecunda include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help to relieve stress and anxiety, as well as ease muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Verbena verecunda include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
